decisions.reason: Although the firm has strong R&D, submarine interior lighting is distant from its main knowledge base, so management is less able to learn from early market feedback and is more likely to redeploy resources elsewhere.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's established industrial lighting capabilities, and the 2019 LED replacement update shows active learning and continued commitment.
This task light is close to the firm's existing offer and even appears as a relaunch of a known product, which makes it easier for management to refine and retain.
A pendant office luminaire fits the firm's core professional building and workplace business, so with in-house R&D and an expanding market the product is likely to be maintained.

The premium pendant luminaire is still close to the firm's established lighting competences, though its more premium positioning makes rationalisation somewhat more plausible than for the more standard office offering.
